helper.title: Train orders helper
helper.subtitle: Information that may be useful for completing the header, footer and instruction fields of new train orders
helper.reminder: Select instructions in the order to display help on how to complete them below

header.name: Order's header
header.B: date the train order was issued (DD.MM.YYYY format)
header.C: name of the station / signal box / line where the vehicle receiving the order is located
header.D: name of the signal box issuing the train order

footer.name: Order's footer
footer.Y: time the train order was issued
footer.Z: train order identifier; RD indicates that the order is issued as a printed form (for simulator purposes it's not editable) - to be completed:
footer.Z-2: scenery identifier (for simulator purposes this may be the telegraphic shortcut of the scenery, its hash, etc.)
footer.Z-3: last two digits of the calendar year (2026 - 26, 2027 - 27, etc.)

22.description: Applies to movements from and onto the wrong-direction line. Instruction for arrivals, departures and continuation of movement after stopping from/on the wrong-direction line.
22.warnings: Instruction 22 shall be issued together with instruction 21.10, 21.15 or 21.35.

99.description: Instruction used to cancel a previously issued written order.

fields.x1: x.1: Identifier of the written order (from its "Z" field) to be cancelled

2110.description:
Departure (dispatching a train) from a signal box or movement within a signal box in the following cases:
  • it is not possible to display a proceed aspect on the departure signal(s), group departure route signal(s), route signal(s) or group route signal(s)
  • no departure signal is provided for the track from which the train is to depart onto the line section
  • no route signal or group route signal is provided for the track from which the movement is to take place within the signal box
2110.warnings: When instruction 21.10 is issued, instruction 21.15 must not be issued simultaneously. One form may authorise passing up to three signals (or a D1 stop board) that are not displaying a proceed aspect.

fields.x1: x.1: Track number from which the train departs (numeric or alphanumeric designation, e.g. 2, 3d)
fields.x2: x.2: Name of the signal box from which the train is dispatched
fields.x3: x.3: Line or station track number to which the train is dispatched (numeric or alphanumeric designation, e.g. 1, 101a)
fields.x4: x.4: Name of the signal box towards which the train is dispatched
fields.x5-7: x.5, x.6, x.7: Identification of signals displaying no proceed aspect and authorised to be passed under this written order. For main signals use letter or alphanumeric designations; for other signals specify the signal type and kilometre location (e.g. D1/73.200).

2115.description:
Arrival (receiving a train) at a signal box or movement within a signal box in the following cases:
  • it is not possible to display a proceed aspect on route signal(s) or group route signal(s)
  • no home signal is provided
  • arrival from a closed line without a home signal
  • it is not possible to display a proceed aspect on a controlled block signal (including automated block signal box - APO)
2115.warnings: When instruction 21.15 is issued, instruction 21.10 must not be issued simultaneously. One form may authorise passing up to three signals (or a D1 stop board) that are not displaying a proceed aspect.

fields.x1: x.1: Track number from which the train arrives (numeric or alphanumeric designation, e.g. 2, 3d)
fields.x2: x.2: Name of the signal box receiving the train
fields.x3: x.3: Track number on which the train is received (numeric or alphanumeric designation, e.g. 2, 3d)
fields.x4-6: x.4, x.5, x.6: Identification of signals displaying no proceed aspect and authorised to be passed under this written order. For main signals use letter or alphanumeric designations; for other signals specify the signal type and kilometre location (e.g. D1/73.200).

2120.description:
Used in the following cases:
  • cancellation of aspects displayed by automatic block signalling (SBL)
  • failure of the SBL system
  • occupation of three or more block sections on a line equipped with SBL
  • introduction of train reporting by telephone on lines equipped with SBL

fields.x1: x.1: Name of the signal box from which the train is dispatched
fields.x2: x.2: Name of the signal box to which the train is dispatched
fields.x3: x.3: Line track number for which the indications of the SBL signals are cancelled (numeric or alphanumeric designation, e.g. 1, 3Ł)

2125.description: Authorisation for a shunting movement beyond the W5 shunting limit board, or beyond the last turnout where no W5 board is provided, when the movement is onto a single-track line or against the normal direction on a double-track line.

fields.x1: x.1: Name of the signal box from which shunting movements are to take place
fields.x2: x.2: Track number over which the shunting movement will pass beyond the shunting limit (numeric or alphanumeric designation, e.g. 1, 3Ł)
fields.x3: x.3: Kilometre location up to which the shunting movement may proceed
fields.x4: x.4: Time at which shunting movements must be completed

2135.description:
Used in the following cases:
  • authorisation to proceed when the rail vehicle is beyond a signal displaying a proceed aspect which the driver cannot see
  • authorisation for a stopped train routed onto the normal-direction line to continue after its front end has passed a signal displaying indicator W24
  • authorisation for a train stopped beyond a controlled signal where the proceed aspect has already changed to S1 'Stop', or changed before the front of the train passed the signal
  • the need to issue authorisation/instructions to start or continue movement following incidents or potentially unsafe situations

fields.x1: x.1: Track number adjacent to the signal whose proceed aspect changed to Stop or which is not visible to the driver (numeric or alphanumeric designation, e.g. 2, 3d)
fields.x2: x.2: For arrival at a signal box – the name of that signal box; for departure onto a line section – the name of the next signal box towards which the movement is taking place

2140.description:
Used in the following cases:
  • ordering a train to stop at a station or passenger stop where it has no scheduled stop
  • ordering an unscheduled stop on a line section, specifying the purpose and duration of the stop
2140.warnings: A separate written order shall be issued for each additional stop.

fields.x1: x.1: Name of the signal box where the stop is to take place; for a stop on a line section enter the name of the signal box at the beginning of that section
fields.x2: x.2: Name of the signal box at the end of the line section where the stop is to take place; leave blank for a stop at a signal box
fields.x3: x.3: Kilometre location of the stop; mandatory for a stop on a line section, optional for a stop at a signal box (enter a dash if not used)

2145.description:
Used in the following cases:
  • ordering a train to stop before a defective controlled signal
  • advising that a proceed aspect displayed on a signal is invalid

fields.x1: x.1: Name of the signal box where the defective signal or signal displaying an invalid proceed aspect is located
fields.x2: x.2: Designation of the signal to which the order applies (letter or alphanumeric designation, e.g. A, B2)

2150.description: Used to advise that the indications of level crossing signalling associated with controlled level crossings and pedestrian crossings, where road traffic control is provided, are cancelled.

fields.x1: x.1: Name of the signal box in whose area the warning boards are located; if the boards are located on a line section, enter the name of the signal box at the beginning of that section (according to the direction of travel)
fields.x2: x.2: Name of the signal box at the end of the line section; if the warning boards are located within a signal box, leave blank
fields.x3: x.3: Kilometre location of the axis of the level crossing to which the warning boards with cancelled indications apply

2155.description: Used to advise of a failure of trackside SHP train protection equipment.

fields.x1: x.1: Name of the signal box in whose area the defective SHP equipment is located; if the equipment is located on a line section, enter the name of the signal box at the beginning of that section (according to the direction of travel)
fields.x2: x.2: Name of the signal box at the end of the line section; if the SHP equipment is located within a signal box, leave blank
fields.x3: x.3: Designation of the signal associated with the SHP balise/resonator. Use a letter or alphanumeric signal designation, e.g. A, J105

2160.description: Used to advise that a train will operate over a route different from that specified in the working timetable.

fields.x1: x.1: Name of the signal box from which the route alteration begins
fields.x2: x.2: Name of the signal box up to which the train will operate over the altered route
fields.x3: x.3: Name of the signal box through which the train will pass on the altered route
fields.x4: x.4: Line number(s) over which the train will operate on the altered route, separated by commas (in a simulation environment, route section names may be used)
fields.x5: x.5: Maximum permitted speed for the altered route; leave blank if the train crew is familiar with the route section(s)

2165.description: Used to advise of the requirement to lower pantographs.

fields.x1: x.1: Kilometre location from which operation with lowered pantographs is required
fields.x2: x.2: Kilometre location up to which operation with lowered pantographs is required

2170.description: Used to instruct a change from GSM-R communications to analogue radio communications over a specified section.

fields.x1: x.1: Name of the signal box from which the communication change applies
fields.x2: x.2: Name of the signal box up to which analogue communications shall be used
fields.x3: x.3: Line number(s) on which analogue communications shall apply, separated by commas

2180.description: Used when dispatching a train onto a closed line.
2180.warnings: If instruction 21.80 is issued together with 21.81, instruction 21.82 must not be issued.

fields.x1: x.1: Number of the closed line track number over which the engineering train will operate
fields.x2: x.2: Name of the signal box towards which the train is dispatched
fields.x3: x.3: Kilometre location up to which the train may proceed
fields.x4: x.4: Name of the signal box to which the train must return after completion of work
fields.x5: x.5: Time by which the train must clear the closed line and return to the signal box

2181.description: Used when there are no other trains on the closed line and no additional trains will be dispatched onto it. Issued together with instruction 21.80.
2181.warnings: If instruction 21.81 is issued together with 21.80, instruction 21.82 must not be issued.

2182.description: Used when another engineering train or trains are already operating on the closed line. To be issued together with instruction 21.80.
2182.warnings: If instruction 21.82 is issued together with 21.80, instruction 21.81 must not be issued. If more than one engineering train is present on the line section, specify only the nearest train (immediately ahead of or behind the train being dispatched).

fields.x1: x.1: Train number of the engineering train operating on the closed line immediately ahead of the train being dispatched
fields.x2: x.2: Kilometre location of the engineering train operating on the closed line

2183.description: Used when another train will be dispatched onto the closed line behind the engineering train being dispatched. To be issued together with instruction 21.80.
2183.warnings: If more than one engineering train is present on the line section, specify only the nearest train (immediately ahead of or behind the train being dispatched).

fields.x1: x.1: Train number of the engineering train that will be dispatched onto the closed line immediately behind the train being dispatched
fields.x2: x.2: Kilometre location up to which the dispatched train is authorised to proceed

2185.description: Used to authorise the placement of a road-rail vehicle (RRV) capable of operating both on roads and railway tracks. To be issued together with instruction 21.80.
2185.warnings: No written order is required when placing an RRV onto a station track. The planned location where the RRV will leave the closed line shall be entered in instruction 21.80, field x.4.

fields.x1: x.1: Number of the closed track number onto which the RRV is to be placed
fields.x2: x.2: Kilometre location where the vehicle is to be placed on the line
fields.x3: x.3: Name of the signal box at the beginning of the line section where the vehicle is to be placed
fields.x4: x.4: Name of the signal box at the end of the line section where the vehicle is to be placed

2310.description: Used when special caution is required and a speed restriction must be observed.
2310.warnings: Up to three speed restrictions may be specified in a single written order. Select the first, second and/or third restriction and complete the corresponding fields.

fields.x1: x.1, x.7, x.13: Name of the signal box at the beginning of the line section where the speed restriction applies; if the restriction is within a signal box, enter its name
fields.x2: x.2, x.8, x.14: Name of the signal box at the end of the line section where the speed restriction applies; if the restriction is within a signal box, leave blank
fields.x3: x.3, x.9, x.15: Track number on which the speed restriction applies
fields.x4: x.4, x.10, x.16: Maximum permitted speed in km/h under the restriction
fields.x5: x.5, x.11, x.17: Kilometre location at which the restriction begins
fields.x6: x.6, x.12, x.18: Kilometre location at which the restriction ends
fields.x91: x.91, x.92, x.93: Reason for the speed restriction

2311.description: Used when the driver of a rail vehicle passing through a speed restriction section is required to sound the 'Attention' warning horn signal. To be issued together with instruction 23.10.

fields.x1: x.1: Kilometre location at which the requirement to sound the warning horn begins
fields.x2: x.2: Kilometre location at which the requirement to sound the warning horn ends

2320.description: Used to communicate authorisations, instructions and information not otherwise covered by the standard form.

fields.x96: x.96: Any authorisations, instructions or information not included elsewhere in the form but required for the safe operation of the train
